_confidence_tiers.educational: explained in prose only; no measurable proxy in our data
_confidence_tiers.analytical: has a defined, computable proxy metric in our data (may still be imperfect)
_confidence_tiers.detectable: actively detected/labeled by code in this repo, not just described
_confidence_tiers.tracking_dependent: the analytical proxy requires tracking data, which we only have for 17 matches (SkillCorner + IDSSE), not the 495 event-only matches
_confidence_tiers.unsupported: we don't attempt to measure this at all - would need data or modeling we don't have

concepts.name: High press
concepts.beginner_explanation: The team without the ball tries to win it back high up the pitch, close to the opponent's goal, instead of retreating.
concepts.analytical_definition: Low PPDA (passes allowed per defensive action) in the opponent's build-up zone - fewer passes before a defensive action means more aggressive pressing.
concepts.limitations: PPDA is a proxy, not a direct press-intensity measure - it can't distinguish organized pressing from a team that happens to concede possession high up. Validated on real WC2022 data: Spain/Germany (known high-press sides) rank at the top, Morocco (known deep block) near the bottom.

concepts.name: Mid-block
concepts.beginner_explanation: The team sits in a compact shape around the halfway line, inviting the opponent forward before engaging.
concepts.analytical_definition: Moderate PPDA (not the highest or lowest) combined with a compact defensive shape.
concepts.limitations: We compute the PPDA half of this; the compactness half is tracking-dependent and only available for 17 matches.

concepts.name: Low block
concepts.beginner_explanation: The team defends deep, close to their own goal, prioritizing compactness over pressing.
concepts.analytical_definition: High PPDA (opponent allowed many passes before a defensive action).
concepts.limitations: Validated: Qatar/Costa Rica/Poland (weak WC2022 sides known for sitting deep) rank highest PPDA in our data.

concepts.name: Counterattack
concepts.beginner_explanation: A fast attack launched immediately after winning the ball back, before the opponent can reorganize defensively.
concepts.analytical_definition: A turnover (recovery/interception/duel/block) followed by a shot from the same team within 15 seconds, covering at least 30m upfield.
required_data: event data with timestamps and x,y
concepts.limitations: A rule-based heuristic, not a trained classifier - deliberately low-recall (finds clear cases, misses ambiguous ones) rather than over-labeling. Always reported as confidence="medium", never as ground truth.

concepts.name: Progressive action (pass/carry)
concepts.beginner_explanation: Moving the ball meaningfully closer to the opponent's goal, by pass or dribble.
concepts.analytical_definition: A pass or carry that reduces the distance to goal by at least 25%.
concepts.limitations: The naive definition rewards goalkeeper long punts - excluded by default in player-level aggregation (see README known gotchas).

concepts.name: Build-up play
concepts.beginner_explanation: How a team moves the ball from their own defensive third into midfield and attack, usually starting from the goalkeeper or center-backs.
concepts.analytical_definition: Possession chains starting in the defensive third, measured by pass volume/completion and progression rate.
concepts.detection_method: not yet implemented as a dedicated feature - derivable from event sequencing
concepts.limitations: No dedicated build-up detector exists yet; would need possession-chain segmentation.

concepts.name: Transition (attacking/defensive)
concepts.beginner_explanation: The moment right after possession changes, when a team is switching from attacking to defending shape or vice versa.
concepts.analytical_definition: The counterattack detector captures the attacking-transition case; defensive transition (re-shaping after losing the ball) is not separately measured.
concepts.limitations: Only the attacking half of transition play is detected.

concepts.name: Gegenpressing (counter-press)
concepts.beginner_explanation: Pressing the opponent immediately after losing the ball, trying to win it back within a few seconds rather than retreating.
concepts.analytical_definition: Would require: defensive action within N seconds of losing possession, in the zone where possession was lost.
required_data: event data with precise possession-loss timestamps
concepts.limitations: Not implemented - conceptually similar to the counterattack detector but inverted (defensive, not attacking) and not built yet.

concepts.name: Overload
concepts.beginner_explanation: Putting more players than the opponent has in a specific area of the pitch, to create a numbers advantage.
concepts.analytical_definition: Would require simultaneous player positions in a zone - a tracking-dependent measure.
concepts.detection_method: not implemented - would use tracking_team_match-style frame data, zoned
concepts.limitations: We have tracking for only 17 matches; no zone-overload detector built yet even for those.

concepts.name: Overlapping run
concepts.beginner_explanation: A player runs around the outside of a teammate who has the ball, usually a fullback overlapping a winger.
concepts.analytical_definition: Would require identifying a specific off-ball run pattern relative to the ball carrier - needs tracking.
concepts.limitations: Not attempted. Even SkillCorner's own "dynamic events" off-ball-run classification (which we don't ingest) would be a closer starting point than our event data.

concepts.name: Underlapping run
concepts.beginner_explanation: A player runs inside (rather than around the outside of) a teammate who has the ball.

concepts.name: Third-man combination
concepts.beginner_explanation: A passing pattern where the ball goes A-to-B, then B-to-C, where C's run was set up in advance - the "third man" exploiting space the first two players created.
concepts.analytical_definition: Would require sequence-pattern matching across 3+ consecutive passes with specific spatial/timing structure.
required_data: event data (feasible in principle) - not built
concepts.limitations: Plausible to build from event data alone (unlike overlap/underlap), just not implemented yet - a real candidate for future sequence-search work.

concepts.name: Half-space occupation
concepts.beginner_explanation: The vertical stripes of the pitch between the wide channels and the center are called half-spaces - valuable areas for creating chances, harder for defenses to cover.
concepts.analytical_definition: Share of touches/progressive actions occurring in the half-space zones (roughly the 2nd and 4th of 5 vertical pitch strips).
concepts.detection_method: computable from event x,y but not yet implemented as a named feature
concepts.limitations: Not built yet - straightforward extension of existing x,y event data, flagged as a good next feature.

concepts.name: Defensive compactness
concepts.beginner_explanation: How close together a team's players are when defending - a compact team is harder to play through.
concepts.analytical_definition: Standard deviation of player x/y positions (width/length) during defensive phases.
concepts.limitations: Only available for the 17 tracking matches. Current metric is whole-match average, not split into attacking/defending phases - a real next step.

concepts.name: False nine
concepts.beginner_explanation: A center-forward who drops deep into midfield instead of staying on the last defensive line, dragging a center-back out of position.
concepts.analytical_definition: Would require positional-role deviation analysis (a nominal CF with a midfielder-like touch heatmap).
required_data: event data (touch locations) - plausible but not built
concepts.limitations: Plausible from touch-location data alone; not implemented.

concepts.name: Possession-based play
concepts.beginner_explanation: A team that prioritizes keeping the ball, building patiently through many short passes, over direct/vertical play.
concepts.analytical_definition: Pass volume per match, pass completion %, average pass length.
concepts.detection_method: computable from event table directly (pass count/completion already used in match_profile)
concepts.limitations: Basic version exists in match_profile; no season-level aggregation yet.

concepts.name: Offside trap
concepts.beginner_explanation: The defensive line steps up together just before the opponent plays a through ball, aiming to catch an attacker offside.
concepts.analytical_definition: Would require coordinated defensive-line-height changes timed to opponent passes - tracking-dependent.
required_data: tracking data + defensive line coordination detection
concepts.limitations: Not attempted - a genuinely hard detection problem even with tracking data.
